name: vendor.openwop-app.workflows.claude-code
description: Hand a coding task to your own Claude Code from a workflow (ADR 0785). Requires the Claude Code feature and a paired device with workflow tasks allowed.

chains.label: Ask Claude Code to make a change
chains.description: Sends one task to Claude Code on a device you have allowed to take workflow tasks, waits for it to finish, and returns its summary. Requires Claude Code: pair a device, then turn on Workflow tasks for it on the Claude Code page.

prompt.description: What Claude Code should do, in plain language.
prompt.default: Run the test suite and summarize any failures.
